name: Is there a difference between a roof inspection and a wear-and-tear assessment?

mainEntity.name: Is there a difference between a roof inspection and a wear-and-tear assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: While often used interchangeably, a roof inspection can be a broader term covering various checks. A wear-and-tear assessment specifically focuses on identifying and evaluating the natural degradation of roofing materials over time, distinguishing it from acute damage. Our assessments are tailored to provide a clear picture of your roof's age-related condition, which is a key factor in determining its remaining lifespan and maintenance needs, aiding in proactive planning.
acceptedAnswer.description: A wear-and-tear assessment specifically evaluates natural roof degradation over time, distinguishing it from other types of roof inspections and informing lifespan estimates.
